// A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curious by nature.
Always building.

Hey, I'm Justin. I work on web projects, experiment with different technologies, and spend a good amount of time exploring cybersecurity.

I enjoy building things that work, figuring out why they don't, and finding ways to make them better. Whether it's developing an application, testing a web service, or messing around in a security lab, I'm always up for a good technical challenge.

My background includes working as a computer instructor and later as an English teacher. Those experiences shaped the way I approach collaboration: communicate clearly, stay patient, and make complicated things easier to understand.
